definitions: calls on (a deity or spirit) in prayer, as a witness, or for inspiration.
cites or appeals to (someone or something) as an authority for an action or in support of an argument.
causes (something) to appear or to be felt.
examples: He invokes the Muses to inspire him.
The defence invokes the Fifth Amendment.
The wizard invokes a powerful demon.
The music invokes a sense of nostalgia.
